desc: Implement a function to compute combinations C(n, k) modulo 10^9+7 using precomputed factorials and inverse factorials.
Implement modular exponentiation to compute (m-1)^(n-1-k) modulo 10^9+7.
Calculate the result as: m * C(n-1, k) * pow(m-1, n-1-k, mod) % mod.
Handle edge cases where m=1 and k must be n-1 (only one possible array if k=n-1, else 0).
